factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for cabezon.
factors.value_notes: Reviewed CDFG and ODFW sources document cabezon distribution, habitat and depth but do not establish a numeric preferred satellite-SST interval. The configured 8-16 °C range and 10-14 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific thermal evidence; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for cabezon.
factors.value_notes: CDFG reports adult cabezon from intertidal waters to 110 m, most commonly intertidal to 30 m; juveniles use tidepools, and egg nests occur intertidally to 15 m. Adults associate with hard bottoms including rocky/artificial reefs, platforms and wrecks. This supports shallow depth/habitat relevance but not the configured 2-50 m / 4-45 m ideal across all life stages.
